commandDescriptions.new: Create the profile and folders of a draft character.
commandDescriptions.list: List characters and their local states.
commandDescriptions.validate: Check record consistency for one or all characters.
commandDescriptions.prompt: Build a prompt from the persona, shot and references.
commandDescriptions.canon-hash: Calculate the identity hash for its approval record.
commandDescriptions.canon-snapshot: Preserve an approved canon version and its reference files.
commandDescriptions.file-hash: Calculate the hash of a character file.
commandDescriptions.register: Register a draft media file in the asset manifest.
commandDescriptions.execution-seal: Preserve the reported generation context and prompt of an asset.
commandDescriptions.migrate-assets: Preserve legacy records in the current format without inventing approvals.
commandDescriptions.narrative-save: Save a new narrative version and its review when supplied.
commandDescriptions.narrative-show: Read the current narrative or an earlier version.
commandDescriptions.content-save: Save a new content piece version with script and context links.
commandDescriptions.run-start: Start a workflow and return the next task package.
commandDescriptions.run-status: Read run state, owner, prerequisites and changes.
commandDescriptions.run-step: Record a transition and evidence of work that actually occurred.
commandDescriptions.run-resume: Resume work; context changes require an explicit new attempt.
commandDescriptions.backup: Create a character backup with inventory and linked runs.
commandDescriptions.backup-test: Test restoration in a temporary copy.
commandDescriptions.restore: Restore a backup without overwriting an existing character.
commandDescriptions.check-assets: Check character and asset record consistency.
commandDescriptions.doctor: Check instructions, templates, guides, framework and skill installation.
